meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会调用 Centinela 代理做安全审计：按 OWASP Top 10 逐项查，扫描硬编码密钥、依赖漏洞，有 Solidity 则查智能合约；最后裁决并生成报告到 docs/reviews 目录，交接给 Dev 代理。只记录不修复。
howto.when: 当你使用 /security-audit 命令时触发，例如发布前、代码重大变动后、新增依赖时等场景。未指定范围时默认审计整个 src/ 目录。

say.note: 无参数时默认审计 src/ 目录并输出报告
同时审计 auth 和 api 两个目录

howto.what_en: After install, Claude runs a security audit via Centinela: OWASP Top 10, secret/dependency scans, smart-contract checks if Solidity. It issues a verdict, writes report to docs/reviews, and hands off to Dev. Documents only, never fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you use the /security-audit command, e.g. before a release, after major code changes, or when adding dependencies. Without a scope, it audits the entire src/ directory by default.

say_en.note: Without arguments, audits src/ by default and outputs a report.
Audits both the auth and api directories.
